The Schweppes 300ml Pineapple drink is here to give you a lip-smacking drinking experience. To maintain the optimum temperature, you can add a few ice cubes (up to three), but it is important that the water used for the cubes has a neutral taste, so as not to affect the taste. As you wish, you can complete your ideal glass with a slice of lemon to add a splash of freshness, fragrance and colour. A sip of history The famous Coca-Cola Original Taste drink was born in 1886 in Atlanta, from the blend of Dr. John Stith Pemberton's delicious cola syrup with carbonated water. At the time it was served to the glass in the Jacobs pharmacy, but shortly thereafter it began to make its way to tables around the world. His recipe is secret, carefully guarded for 136 years but at the same time shared on tables all over the world, generation after generation: a little secret that holds a universe of taste. A unique taste, like you.
